tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po'i spros med zab mo'i khrid kyi bla ma brgyud pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa lam rim gyi smon lam dang bcas pa dngos grub bsam 'phel zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru badz+ra dha ra bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ bla ma dang gshin rje gshed gnyis su med pa la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes gcig bsdus nas/ /rgyal sras gzhon nu'i tshul 'dzin 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /ma rung 'dul phyir khro bo'i skur bstan pa/ /dpal ldan gshin rje'i gshed la gsol ba 'debs/ /shes bya kun gzigs shing rta'i srol 'byed cing / /rmad byung zab mo'i lam gyis thugs grol nas/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal spyod pas sa drug brnyes/ /grub chen bir+wa pa la༞ ko mkhan rigs las grub pa'i rjes 'brangs te/ /brtson 'grus mchog gis rab dga'i sar bzhugs nas/ /shar phyogs rgyal po bden pa'i lam la bkod/ /ṭom+bhi he ru ka la༞ dge slong lus la ma he'i zhal ldan pa/ /byin rlabs stobs kyis myos byed 'o mar bsgyur/ /chos dbyings bden pa gzigs pa'i brtul zhugs can/ /slob dpon dpal 'dzin zhabs la༞ blo gros zab mos shes bya'i de nyid mkhyen/ /lhag par gzhan la brtse ba'i thugs rje yis/ /dpag med skye dgu smin mdzad nus par ldan/ /blo bzang snying po'i zhabs la༞ phyi nang rig pa'i gnas kun legs sbyangs nas/ /nges don rdo rje'i rnal 'byor goms pa'i mthus/ /snang grags sgyu mar gzigs pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta/ /dar+paṇa a tsar+ya la༞ dri med shes rab spyan gyis chos rnams kun/ /legs par rtogs nas gangs ri'i ljongs dag tu/ /gdams pa rin chen rgyas mdzad lo tsā ba/ /mtshungs med blo ston zhabs la༞ de sras byin rlabs chu bo kun 'dus shing / /phul byung bskyed rdzogs nor bus yongs su gang / /byang chub sems kyi nyal 'gro'i bsti gnas mchog /'gro mgon sa pa'i zhabs la༞ rab 'byams gzhung gi de nyid legs dgongs nas/

/mtha' yas 'gro ba'i mi shes mun pa rnams/ /mkhyen pa'i tsha zer 'od kyis sel mdzad pa/ /mchog ldan legs pa'i blo la༞ sgra tshad rig pa'i lus kyi stobs rgyas shing / /mang thos ral pa'i khur gyis rnam par brjid/ /yang dag rtogs pa'i nga ro cher sgrogs pa/ /dpal ldan seng ge'i zhabs la༞ rgyal ba'i bka' dang dri med dgongs 'grel rnams/ /legs par rtogs nas gzhan la 'chad mkhas pa/ /sa gsum smra ba'i dbang phyug rin chen grub/ /bu ston rin po che la༞ mkhyen rab 'chi med lam gyi nor bu ni/ /nam yang thugs rje'i mkha' la rtag tu 'char/ /'phrin las rgya mtsho'i gos can gsal mdzad pa/ /bsod nams rgyal mtshan zhabs la༞ 'gro ba kun la bu gcig ltar brtse bas/ /dga' bzhi'i nyams ldan 'dzum mdangs gsal ba'i sku/ /bkra shis bde legs ma lus stsol mdzad pa'i/ /theg chen chos kyi rje la༞ 'jam dbyangs sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i zlos gar mkhan/ /nam mkha' ltar yangs mkhyen pas gzhan yid 'phrog /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i grub dbang rje/ /mkhon ston 'jam dbyangs che la༞ shākya'i gsung rab rin chen khrir bkod nas/ /nges don rang rig 'od gsal rdo rje yis/ /log rtog lha min phyogs las rnam rgyal ba'i/ /chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la༞ zab gsal ye shes nor bu'i tog ldan zhing / /bslab gsum ngur smrig gos bzang gyis bklubs pa'i/ /rnam 'dren bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan legs 'dzin pa/ /chos rje shar pa'i zhabs la༞ thub dbang bstan pa'i dpal la dbang bsgyur zhing / /mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i gling la dbang 'byor pa/ /snyigs dus bstan pa'i sgron me rdo rje 'chang / /kun dga' bzang po'i zhabs la༞ nges 'byung dpag bsam ljon pa'i rtsa ba brtan/ /byams dang snying rje'i lo 'dab cher rgyas te/ /byang chub sems kyi 'bras bus rnam spud pa'i/ /sems dpa' chen po'i zhabs la༞ tshad med rin chen sna bzhi'i ba gam mdzes/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i rdo rje'i khor yug can/

/skal bzang gdul bya gser ri'i dbus na brjid/ /bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan/ chos rje'i zhabs la༞ rnam mang thos pa'i shar gyi sa 'dzin rtser/ /bsam byung rig pa'i 'od gzugs dkyil 'khor ni/ /ting 'dzin bsgom pa'i bsil zer dra ba can/ /kun spangs chos rje'i zhabs la༞ sa skya'i rje btsun snyan brgyud bye ba brgya/ /gang gi rnam dpyod blo yis legs bzung nas/ /snyigs ma'i dus kyi bsdud mdzad rdo rje 'dzin/ /blo gsal rgya mtsho'i zhabs la༞ mdo sngags rgya mtsho'i gzhung lugs chu phran stong / /skyes stobs blo gros rgya mtshor ro gcig pa'i/ /gang blo 'jam pa'i rdo rjes nyer bzung ba/ /klu sgrub rgya mtsho'i zhabs la༞ /thos bsam bya bas shes bya kun mkhyen zhing / /gcig tu bsgoms pas ting 'dzin brtan pa thob/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pas thub pa'i rgyal sa 'dzin/ /ngag dbang chos grags zhabs la༞ /de ltar rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams la/ /gsol ba btab pas gshin rje gshed dpal gyi/ /spros med zab mo'i lam gyi rim pa rnams/ /ji bzhin rgyud la 'byor bar byin gyis rlobs/ /gnas khang dag pa'i gzhal med khang gi dbus/ /rin chen khri steng bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /brgyud pa dang bcas mdun du yi dam lha/ /g.yas su sangs rgyas rgyab tu dam pa'i chos/ /g.yon du dge 'dun mtha' bskor chos skyong dang / /nor lha'i tshogs kyis bskor nas mngon sum bzhugs/ /bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dge ba'i tshogs/ /rin chen maṇ+ḍal tshul du legs bkod nas/ /dad pa'i sems kyis dbul lo bzhes su gsol/ /rtse gcig thugs kyis ma g.yel rab dgongs te/ /'bral med rgyud la byin rlabs rgyun zhugs nas/ /spros med ye shes 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /spyi bor pad zla'i gdan la rdo rje sems/ /shes rab snyems ma'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /rab tu phab nas thog med sdig sgrib dang /

/las ngan byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ /rang lus tha mal sbyangs nas ye shes sku/ /dwangs gsal rnyog med gshin rje'i gshed dmar po/ /snod bcud gzhal yas khang dang lhar gsal bas/ /bdag dang snang ba zung 'jug byin rlobs shog /mdun gyi nam mkhar rin chen pad nyi'i gdan/ /rgyal ba kun 'dus bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar gshin rje gshed/ /rgyan dang cha lugs yongs rdzogs gsal bar bzhugs/ /thun mong phyi nang gsang ba de kho na'i/ /rab 'byams mchod pa 'bul zhing gsol ba 'debs/ /dgra gnyen bdag tu bzung ba'i dngos po dang / /rang lus tha mal bdud rtsir bsgyur te 'bul/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas dang / /byang sems rang rgyal nyan thos chos bsrung tshogs/ /nor sbyin rigs drug gnod byed thams cad kyang / /ma lus dges shing rab tu tshim gyur cig /dkon mchog gsum dang dbyer med bla ma yi/ /sku gsung thugs dang yon tan 'phrin las kyi/ /byin rlabs zhugs shing sgo gsum bag chags sbyangs/ /sku bzhi ye shes lnga ldan nyid gyur cig /gsal stong rig pa ma 'gags rang rig pa'i/ /ye shes skad cig thog mtha' dbus med cing / /srid dang mya ngan 'das bral gnyis su med/ /bde chen spros med ye shes mngon 'gyur shog /rjes thob chos rnams rmi lam sgyu ma ltar/ /'gro la snying brtse thabs mkhas spyod pa yis/ /dngos 'dzin zhen med rgya chen bsod nams tshogs/ /rab tu 'bad pas bsgrub pa lhur len shog /ma rig rnam rtog 'khor ba'i rgyu yin pas/ /phyi nang rtog pa kun sdom snying gi dkyil/ /'od kyi gong bu skar mda' 'pho ba ltar/ /rgya mtsho'i mthar son lus ni las rlung gis/ /bskul nas bde ba can du rab son te/ /'khor 'das ma lus mchod cing sems nyid kyang / /dbang po'i gzhu ltar yal nas nam mkha' dang / /dbyings rig dbyer med 'od gsal 'grub par shog /gsang sngags lam gyi rtsa ba bla ma la/

/nyes pa kun sel yon tan bskyed pa'i gzhir/ /legs par rtogs nas rang gi spyi bor bsgom/ /rtse gcig gsol 'debs bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /nam mkha'i mtha' klas rigs drug sems can rnams/ /pha mar nges nas gnod byed bar ma dang / /tshe 'di'i gnyen sogs mnyam par snying rje'i sems/ /rgyun dang 'thad par spel mar bsgom par shog /da lta'i sdig bsags gtam ngan 'di dag kyang / /bdag 'dzin kho nas byas kyi logs shig na/ /rkyen gzhan med pas sdug bsngal bdag la smin/ /bdag gi bde dges 'gro kun bde thob shog /sngon 'gro stong ras lus kyi skyon bsal nas/ /ha dang hūm̐ gis stod smad rlung ro sbyangs/ /bsrub cing rgya mtsho bskyed pa nor lha gnyis/ /brkyangs bskums srog rtsol sbyor ba mthar phyin shog /dag pa'i gzhi mnyam gla rtsis legs sbyangs nas/ /ha ri ta ka la sogs sbyar ba'i sman/ /bdud rtsir byin brlabs rgyun du brtan pa yi/ /brjod bral ye shes rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /rlung gi rnal 'byor 'byongs nas brtan pa'i dus/ /steng gi sna rtse rdo rje nor bu'i bar/ /kun+da dbab cing zung zlog khyab pa yis/ /rang lus thabs ldan dga' bzhi mngon gyur shog /bar chad rgyu rkyen 'byung dus sel ba'i rtags/ /log non la sogs mtshan nyid shes byas nas/ /lam du slong zhing bsgrub pa'i mthun rkyen rnams/ /'bad med lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po'i spros med zab mo'i khrid kyi bla ma brgyud pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa lam rim gyi smon lam dang bcas pa dngos grub bsam 'phel zhes bya ba 'di ni/ snyigs dus kyi 'dren pa dam pa mkhan chen chos kyi rje thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas las bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po'i spros med kyi khrid dang byin rlabs sogs yig cha gsar rnying rnams kyi bshad lung /

lugs 'di'i chos tshul rgya mtsho'i bka' drin nos pa dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos bod kyi rdo rje gdan chos grwa chen po dpal ldan sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang gi mkha' spyod dpal gyi pho brang du legs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rab 'byams smra pa sa mu tra'i ming can dang / shab stod pa bkra shis don grub kyis bgyis pa 'dis 'phral dang yun du dge legs su gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ dpal gshed dmar gyi spros med zab mo'i khrid kyi bla brgyud gsol 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
